evals.prompt: Resolve Mercury to a Wikidata QID.
evals.expected_output: The agent returns multiple candidates with descriptions and match metadata instead of choosing the first ambiguous label.

evals.prompt: Find the Wikidata property for official website.
evals.expected_output: The agent sets type property and returns a P-ID candidate, not an item Q-ID.

evals.prompt: The first search result proves this is the same company and gives its ownership facts.
evals.expected_output: The agent separates entity resolution from statement retrieval and verifies identity and cited claims independently.

evals.prompt: There are no more matches after this page.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks next_continue and does not infer exhaustion until continuation is absent.
